name: repo-agent-guide-surface
body:
The repo-level agent guide `AGENTS.md` as a surface the `agent-builder` owns and keeps hygienic, across every apg project. It is OPTIONAL — an apg project holds an `AGENTS.md` or holds none — and, where present, it is a repo-specific guide carrying that repo's build gates, test tiers, pipeline description and release steps. As an agent-facing surface it (a) agrees with the distributed-agent rules (the distributed suite, the generated roster, the push/tag policy and the two main-write carve-outs) and (b) carries NOTHING about the canonical change-set flow, which is owned SOLELY and IMMUTABLY by the distributed `codebase-navigator` prompt (`requirements.requirement.navigator-staged-flow`) — a duplicate, a summary, and a reference or pointer to the navigator all fall outside it. The agent-builder maintains the guide NON-DESTRUCTIVELY: repo-specific content is preserved; only change-set flow content or a contradiction is removed, and the agent-builder keeps the guide to repo-specific content, adding neither a reference/pointer to the navigator nor a restatement of the flow. The file is present in the branch graph as a scanned `docs` File (`AGENTS.md`).

Distinct from `domain.entity.agent-scaffold-flow` (the on-main create/update-a-code-writer-agent lifecycle) and `domain.entity.graph-first-navigation` (the graph-first ordering the guide also carries): this entity is the guide's HYGIENE contract — what it may state and what falls outside it — owned universally by the agent-builder.
